name: Bookman
source:
A player in Second, Thinker's assistant.

[spoiler]A swampman of [url=https://vndb.org/c62393]Ninomae Kuugan[/url]. At first, he believes that he is the same as the original, but after he was showed a differences, he aims to replace the original. He has appeared because [url=https://vndb.org/c62393]Ninomae Kuugan[/url] has completed Thinker System in Second and tested it.[/spoiler]
